[USER] User is looking for vegan Indian recipes.  
[USER] User is interested in vegan versions of popular Indian dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Vegan Indian cuisine is delicious and diverse.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested vegan Indian dishes include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Vegan Chana Masala: Replace yogurt with non-dairy yogurt or cashew cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sag Aloo: Substitute paneer with tofu or soy cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Vegan Tikka Masala: Marinate tofu or tempeh in non-dairy yogurt, lemon juice, and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Dal Makhani: Use vegan butter or oil and skip ghee.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Vegan Samosas: Use vegan pastry or whole wheat/gluten-free alternative.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Vegan Korma: Substitute dairy with non-dairy yogurt or coconut cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Bhindi Masala: Use vegan butter or oil and skip ghee.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Vegan Naan Bread: Replace dairy with non-dairy yogurt or flax egg.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Vegan Rajma Masala: Substitute dairy with non-dairy yogurt or coconut cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Vegan Gulab Jamun: Replace milk solids with non-dairy milk and vegan sweeteners.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include using vegan-friendly spices and experimenting with non-dairy milks.
